name: suede-deslop
description: Suede Slop Stop: the Suede AI context-aware anti-slop pass for finished prose. Finds or removes generic filler, manufactured emphasis, false agency, formulaic structure, chat and draft residue, formatting applied by rule, and the Suede AI house bans (em dashes, moreover, delve, game-changer, unlock, elevate, seamless, landscape, tapestry, rule-of-three rhythm) without flattening the author's voice. Returns cleaned prose with a 50-point score, or a findings-only audit that leaves the text untouch
author: JasonColapietro
